title: Stellaris discovery dataset (astral rifts and archaeological sites)
description: One shape for both datasets. astral_rifts.v2.1.json and archaeological_sites.v2.1.json are single-kind files; stellaris_discovery.v2.1.json merges them and is the file to load if you render both from one component.

kind.description: The kind of every entity in this file, or 'mixed' for the merged file.

mechanics.description: Single-kind files: an array of strings. Merged file: an array of {kind, lines[]}.

reward_codes.description: Expansion of the wiki's {{reward}} template codes. Payouts are a multiplier of your current empire output with a min-max clamp, so these are not flat numbers.

groups.description: Display groupings. 'key' matches entity.group; 'label' matches entity.group_label. The merged file adds a 'kind' field because group keys are only unique within a kind.

id.description: Slug of the name. Unique within a kind, NOT across kinds.

uid.description: Globally unique key. Use this for routing and for joining to reward_finder.entity_id.

group.description: Rifts: unique | precursor | general. Sites: base | unique_system | origin | precursor | ancient_relics | other_expansion.

precursor.description: Baol, Zroni, adAkkaria Convention, Inetian Traders. Null for everything else.

system.description: Named system, where the entity is tied to one.

restrictions.description: Ethic and civic locks. Populated for rifts; always null for sites, where such locks are written into the chapter reward lines instead.

id.description: The wiki's chapter id. Rifts use forms like '4-A', '3/4/5', '2b', or a named node such as 'fungal_bloom'. Sites use a plain ordinal as a string. Never parse this as a number - sort on 'index'.

index.description: 1-based position in this entity's chapter list. Use this for ordering.

title.description: Chapter name. Null for archaeological sites, which the wiki does not title.

rewards.description: One string per reward. May embed a reward code (ast1, rsh3, art2) - expand via reward_codes.

choices.description: One string per clickable option, including difficulty, destination, cost and any ethic lock. Always empty for archaeological sites, which have no branching choice tree.

reward_finder.description: Flat index answering 'I want X, where do I get it?'. Derived from the chapter tables - a reward at several entities gets one row each. Group in the UI by 'category'.

category.description: Relics, Specimens (Grand Archive), Technologies, Empire modifiers, and so on. Category names differ between the two kinds - do not assume a shared vocabulary.

entity.description: Display name. May be a placeholder such as 'several' or '-' on cross-cutting rows.

entity_id.description: Joins to entities[].uid. Null where 'entity' is a placeholder rather than a real entity - handle that before dereferencing.

chapter.description: Chapter id the reward comes from. Populated for sites, null for rifts (use 'path' instead).

path.description: The full click path through the rift. Populated for rifts, null for sites.

assumptions.description: What to pressure-test before shipping on this data. Single-kind files: array of strings. Merged file: array of {kind, text}.
